digest.component_or_area: structured output baseline evaluation CI harness
propositions: A CI evaluation harness is needed to measure raw LLM output distributions before and after sentinel directive changes across provider-model cells (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI) with fixed n=10 per configuration.

The sentinel directive significantly improves output consistency: it raises parse success rates and collapses layout distribution to 100% prose on Anthropic and Bedrock (previously emitting code fences).

Live measurement runs must be operator-triggered via workflow_dispatch with capped API calls (default 300), restricted secret scoping per provider arm, and deterministic scoring logic testable offline against committed golden fixtures.
Missing provider credentials are recorded as unmeasured cells without failing the job, enforced before any network calls are made.

The harness captures raw replies, scores parse success under both current and sentinel parsers, and classifies layout types (prose, fenced, multi_object, quoted-JSON) with results uploaded as CI artifacts.
